notes.mechanism: Which platform publishes through an official interface and which drives a visible operations browser is an internal fact. It changes what the executor does, never what the App renders, so it is deliberately absent from the projected DTO.
notes.availability: A platform that has no credentials configured is 'awaiting_configuration' and stays listed. Hiding it, or failing the whole publishing module because one platform is unconfigured, would leave the operator unable to publish to the platform that IS ready.
notes.approval: 'awaiting_approval' is the critical point. The App must show the target account, the video summary and the copy, and must not offer a way to continue that skips them.
notes.outcomeUncertain: The publish was already attempted and the result could not be established. It is never retried automatically and never rendered as a failure the operator can simply repeat.
